copy.en:
Three-Position Handle, Clear Structure
The aluminium frame and hinged opening provide quicker access than a zipper design.
Foldable phone holder on the handle
Polyester lining inside the case
copy.zh:
拉杆三档调节，结构清晰
铝合金框架配合铰链开合，相比拉链设计更快捷
拉杆配备可折叠手机支架
箱内采用涤纶内衬
copy.de:
Dreifach verstellbarer Griff, klare Struktur
Aluminiumrahmen und Scharnieröffnung ermöglichen schnelleren Zugriff als ein Reißverschluss.
Zusammenklappbare Handyhalterung am Griff
Polyesterfutter im Koffer
copy.fr:
Poignée à trois positions, structure nette
Le cadre en aluminium et l’ouverture à charnières donnent un accès plus rapide qu’une fermeture éclair.
Support de téléphone pliable sur la poignée
Doublure intérieure en polyester
copy.it:
Manico a tre posizioni, struttura chiara
Il telaio in alluminio e l’apertura a cerniera offrono accesso più rapido di una cerniera.
Supporto pieghevole per smartphone sul manico
Fodera interna in poliestere
copy.es:
Asa de tres posiciones, estructura clara
El marco de aluminio y la apertura con bisagra permiten acceder más rápido que con cremallera.
Soporte plegable para teléfono en el asa
Forro interior de poliéster

design_brief_zh: 主卖点是拉杆三档调节，结合铝合金框架与铰链开合，呈现结构证据而非泛化耐用宣传。PC使用2000×2000画布：左侧产品区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.08,0.46,0.84]，右侧文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.57,0.10,0.38,0.80]；移动端使用1200×1200画布：上方产品与结构区[x,y,w,h]=[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，底部文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.64,0.90,0.31]。PC阅读顺序为右侧标题、支持说明、两个细节标注；移动端为上方结构视觉后阅读底部四行文案。产品采用与实物一致的单一颜色和比例，做轻微三维分解：外壳、铝合金框架、铰链开合关系、三档拉杆、折叠手机支架和涤纶内衬分层展示；不得展示看不见或未提供的内部零件。可在边缘以无品牌、低对比度的中性拉链箱轮廓作辅助对比，仅表达铰链开合更快捷，不使用竞品或计时承诺。使用欧洲现代旅行摄影风格、低饱和中性色背景、自然侧光和柔和接触阴影，金属边框保留真实反光，局部放大框准确指向拉杆支架与内衬。标题使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线粗体，支持说明和标注使用清晰常规字重；数字“三档/3”优先保证移动端可读，德语文案预留约20%横向扩展空间。第一行映射拉杆三档调节；第二行映射铝合金框架及铰链开合与拉链对比；第三行映射折叠手机支架；第四行映射涤纶内衬。
compliance_note_zh: 仅展示已提供的铝合金框架、铰链开合、三档拉杆、可折叠手机支架和涤纶内衬事实；不要将整箱表述为铝制，不要虚构材料厚度、测试、认证、静音、强度或官方背书。相比拉链更快捷属于产品资料中的功能对比，可保留中性表达，不延伸为绝对化或计时承诺。不得出现竞品商标、价格、评分、促销信息或未验证的安全保证。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium European-modern exploded-view product image of the exact YWJ 13A travel suitcase shown in the supplied reference, using one matching color and realistic proportions. PC composition: suitcase and separated structural layers on the left 46% of a 2000x2000 canvas, copy-safe negative space on the right 38%; mobile composition: product and detail callouts in the upper 53% of a 1200x1200 canvas, copy-safe space along the bottom 31%. Show the aluminium frame, hinged opening relationship, three-position telescopic handle, foldable phone holder mounted on the handle, and polyester lining as clearly connected, realistic components. Use subtle exploded spacing and fine leader lines without labels or text; do not invent hidden parts. Add only a small, unbranded neutral zipper-case silhouette at the far edge for a restrained visual contrast, never a competitor product. Use low-saturation neutral travel-photography styling, natural side light, soft contact shadows, authentic metal reflections, and a clean modern studio background. Keep the suitcase as the single visual focal point, with close-up inset views of the handle holder and polyester lining. Do not render any text, letters, numbers, logos, icons, badges, measurements, or symbols in the image.
